signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, a suite of AI capabilities embedded in its GRC platform, powered by Anthropic's Claude models.

email.body1:
Mary, saw Onspring just rolled out Onspring AI across the GRC platform.

Shipping a new AI suite usually opens up more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps catch up, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mary, quick follow-up for Onspring.

When a new product ships, the number jumps faster than the team can manually cover every fit account. Most directors don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit target, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mary, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other GRC software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mary, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a product launch, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your GRC motion? I'll tailor it to Onspring either way.
